3M.event: Spun off its entire Health Care business (including its advanced wound care and NPWT lines) into a standalone independent company named Solventum Corporation.
3M.evidence: 3M completed the spin-off of its health care and advanced wound care division into an independent publicly traded company named Solventum Corporation on April 1, 2024. Solventum now manages and offers the V.A.C. Therapy lines of negative pressure wound therapy systems. Source: 3M Company Press Releases and SEC Stock Exchange Filings.
